name: Jimmy Dean Delights Turkey Sausage, Egg White & Cheese English Muffin
whyItWorks: Formulated with 50% less fat than standard pork sausage breakfast sandwiches: lean turkey sausage patty, fluffy egg white, and American cheese on an English muffin. Delivers 17g protein with minimal grease.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Wrap in a paper towel and microwave for 90 seconds. Let sit 1 minute for heat to equalize.
watchOuts: Contains mild American cheese; safe for remission and mild recovery.
